subject.title: feat: add publisher follow graph API

question: Should ClawHub accept this publisher-scoped follow graph API as the base for the stacked follow controls and notification PRs, or pause/re-scope the stack until the API/product boundary is approved?
rationale: The patch is a new private-state API surface rather than a bug fix, and it becomes the foundation for two dependent feature PRs, so implementation review cannot settle whether this is the right product boundary.

options.title: Continue With This Base Slice
options.body: Require the rebase, docs/OpenAPI, sourcemap regeneration, and live HTTP proof, then review this API as the base of the follow stack.

options.title: Review The Stack Together
options.body: Pause this PR until the API, UI controls, discovery, and notification behavior are reviewed as one product boundary.

options.title: Re-scope Before Merge
options.body: Ask for a narrower spec/API proposal before accepting any stored follow graph or API-token route.

recommendation.title: Continue With This Base Slice
recommendation.body: Require the rebase, docs/OpenAPI, sourcemap regeneration, and live HTTP proof, then review this API as the base of the follow stack.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-main owner signal for the adjacent API route, schema package, docs, retention, and Convex schema surfaces touched by this PR.
